queries.name: gate4_negativos_por_campo_servidor
queries.sql:
SELECT
 ServerID, SystemType,
 COUNT_BIG(*) AS Total,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Costo < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CostoNegativo,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CostoPromedio < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PromedioNegativo,
 SUM(CASE WHEN UltimoCosto < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS UltimoNegativo,
 SUM(CASE WHEN Costo = 0 AND CostoPromedio > 0
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CeroConPromedioPositivo
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY Total DESC

queries.name: gate4_insumos_costo_cero_alternativas
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
 ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente,
 Costo, CostoPromedio, UltimoCosto
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
WHERE (Costo = 0 AND CostoPromedio > 0)
   OR (CostoPromedio = 0 AND Costo > 0)
ORDER BY ServerID, CodigoFuente

queries.name: gate4_recetas_huerfanas_por_servidor
queries.sql:
SELECT
 r.ServerID,
 r.SystemType,
 COUNT_BIG(*) AS TotalComponentes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.Encontrado IS NULL
     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinProductoPadre,
 SUM(CASE WHEN i.Encontrado IS NULL
     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinInsumo
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
OUTER APPLY (
 SELECT TOP (1) 1 AS Encontrado
 FROM dbo.Sync_Productos p
 WHERE p.ServerID = r.ServerID
   AND p.SystemType = r.SystemType
   AND p.CodigoFuente = r.ProductoCodigoFuente
) p
OUTER APPLY (
 SELECT TOP (1) 1 AS Encontrado
 FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos i
 WHERE i.ServerID = r.ServerID
   AND i.SystemType = r.SystemType
   AND i.CodigoFuente = r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
) i
GROUP BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType
ORDER BY TotalComponentes DESC

queries.name: gate4_costos_receta_vs_insumo
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
 r.ServerID, r.SystemType,
 r.ProductoCodigoFuente,
 r.ComponenteCodigoFuente,
 r.UnidadMedida,
 r.Cantidad,
 r.CostoUnitario AS CostoReceta,
 i.Costo AS CostoInsumo,
 i.CostoPromedio,
 ABS(r.CostoUnitario - i.Costo) AS Diferencia
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
JOIN dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos i
 ON i.ServerID = r.ServerID
 AND i.SystemType = r.SystemType
 AND i.CodigoFuente = r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
WHERE r.CostoUnitario > 0
  AND i.Costo > 0
  AND ABS(r.CostoUnitario - i.Costo) > 0.01
ORDER BY Diferencia DESC

queries.name: gate4_unidades_costos_cero
queries.sql:
SELECT TOP (100)
 ServerID, SystemType, UnidadMedida,
 COUNT_BIG(*) AS Componentes,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario = 0
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CostoUnitarioCero,
 SUM(CASE WHEN CostoTotal = 0
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CostoTotalCero
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, UnidadMedida
ORDER BY CostoUnitarioCero DESC

queries.name: gate4_mpro_identidad_empresarial
queries.sql:
SELECT
 ServerID, SystemType, EmpresaID,
 COUNT_BIG(*) AS Productos,
 SUM(CASE WHEN UnidadNegocioID IS NULL
          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinUnidadNegocio
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos
WHERE SystemType = 'MPRO'
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, EmpresaID
ORDER BY Productos DESC
